description: License compliance policy for vesting-cliff-drip-stream. All runtime and dev dependencies must carry one of the allowed licenses. Disallowed licenses cause CI to fail unless the package is listed under explicit_exceptions.

explicit_exceptions.reason: ring uses a custom license derived from BoringSSL/OpenSSL; legal reviewed and approved for internal use.

notes.dual_license: For packages with dual licenses (e.g. MIT OR Apache-2.0), the scan selects the most permissive compatible option. Both must be MIT-compatible to pass.
notes.dev_only: Dev-only dependencies (cargo [dev-dependencies] and package.json devDependencies) are still subject to this policy because they run in CI and developer environments.
notes.copyleft_rationale: Copyleft licenses (GPL, LGPL, AGPL) are disallowed because linking or bundling them with this project could impose copyleft obligations on downstream users of the compiled WASM or JavaScript bundles.
